answer: Lock every new identity's deposit in a shared seasonal dividend vault. The vault only pays out after a full season of clean work, so a sybil ring must fund each fake identity and wait months for any return. One fraud claim freezes that identity's payout and burns its deposit, and the loss ripples across the ring because the cohort's dividends shrink when any member cheats. No identity is an island: the vault ties every member's money to the group's honesty, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand deposits and seasons of waiting. Like a crew sharing one catch, cheats starve the whole boat.
